decision: Lock ANALYSIS_PLAN.md v1.0 before Step 2 runs
reason: Pre-specify tests and pass rules so results cannot steer methods
approved_by: RS (2026-10-13); still to sign: TP, MK, NS, LC

decision: Primary outcome = IDMC disaster displacement; UNHCR refugee+asylum becomes secondary
reason: UNHCR flows are mainly conflict-driven; reviewers will reject them as a climate migration measure

decision: Drop carbon intensity (G) from core model
reason: No causal pathway to displacement; earlier pi2 result reproduced by pure-noise simulation

decision: Replace sea-level-rise rate (O) with LECZ population share
reason: SLR rate is near-uniform across countries so O/sqrt(A) acted as a land-size index

decision: No min-max scaling; normalize only by reference scales (world medians)
reason: Min-max subtracts minima and breaks power laws (simulated exponent 1.5 -> 0.58)

decision: Use temperature and precipitation as standardized anomalies
reason: Temperature has its own dimension; anomalies are unitless and physically meaningful for hazards

decision: Pi1 uses WDI health spending as % of GDP (SH.XPD.CHEX.GD.ZS) instead of per-capita PPP spending divided by constant-price GDP
reason: The earlier formula divided current-price $ by constant-2021 $ so the ratio drifted with inflation

decision: Temperature and precipitation anomalies both use the 1991-2020 WMO normal
reason: FAOSTAT change is relative to 1951-1980; mixing baselines would build the warming trend into Pi3 and make it inconsistent with Pi4

decision: Keep OWID co2_per_gdp as a robustness variable only
reason: Lets reviewers see the old paper's carbon variable re-tested on clean data

decision: IDMC outcome M = 'Disaster Internal Displacements (Raw)' summed by ISO3-year (all hazards; pre-emptive evacuations included as IDMC does)
reason: The IDMC file has a rounded column and an unrounded (Raw) one; summing many rounded event figures adds rounding error. Raw is the underlying estimate

decision: UCDP: map GW codes 316/345/678/816 to CZE/SRB/YEM/VNM by hand; economies absent from UCDP (PSE, HKG, MAC, PRI and small territories) get K missing, not 0
reason: country_converter left these four GW codes unmatched, which would have set Yemen's conflict deaths to 0; UCDP records Israel-Palestine violence under Israel so PSE=0 would be false

decision: Montenegro arable land (A_R) set missing for 2008-2012
reason: FAO series drops from 1,730 to 78 km2 in 2013: a reclassification, not a real change. Post-2013 definition kept

decision: Pi3 uses CRU TS annual mean temperature from CCKP (same source and baseline as Pi4); FAOSTAT kept as a cross-check
reason: FAOSTAT has fewer than 25 of 30 baseline years for 12 countries (YEM 1, SGP 0, SDN and SSD none); CRU covers 1901-2023 for all countries

decision: Climate anomaly set missing where one CRU value repeats in 5 or more years of 1991-2023
reason: Repeated values mean CRU had no stations and filled in climatology (found: SLB 14 repeats, CPV 12 in precipitation); such anomalies are not real

decision: Pi8 uses WDI published density (EN.POP.DNST) instead of WDI population / WDI land area
reason: WDI population excludes breakaway regions in GEO and MDA but land area includes them, so the computed ratio understates density by 15-20% there

decision: QA warnings reviewed and accepted: population differs from OWID by 5-6% in ALB BGR ISR MKD POL PSE QAT TTO and 24% in MDA
reason: Definitional differences between WDI and UN WPP (MDA excludes Transnistria); no unit errors. Largest displacement rates (CUB 2008, HTI 2010, PAK 2010 etc.) match known disasters

decision: Steps 2-4 were run once on the real data before D-001 was signed, to check the data only
reason: Needed to find data errors (D-010 to D-016). Only coverage, ranges, units and dimensions were examined; no model was fitted and no outcome-predictor relationship was computed or viewed

decision: Amend D-014: climatology fill = the same CRU value in 4 or more CONSECUTIVE years within 1991-2023 (was: any value repeated in 5 or more years)
reason: On the CRU temperature file the old rule flagged Libya, whose repeats are scattered (22.91 C in 1998, 2004, 2012, 2014, 2023) around real variation. Real fill appears as runs (SLB temperature 13 years in a row). Sample countries affected: SLB (Pr and Tc) and CPV (Pr), as before

decision: Add robustness check: re-run H1 and H4 with Pi3 built from FAOSTAT instead of CRU (countries with a full FAOSTAT baseline)
reason: CRU and FAOSTAT temperature anomalies correlate 0.81 overall but below 0.7 in 27 sample countries, mostly tropical Africa where both have few stations (e.g. UGA 0.18, BGD 0.30). Neither source is clearly better there, so the result must not depend on the choice. Added before any model was fitted

decision: Vanuatu 2015 displacement (M) set missing; raw IDMC file unchanged
reason: IDMC has one Cyclone Pam record "Countrywide - 09/03/2015" of 600,000 displacements, 2.3x the population (266,101); the province-level Pam records for the same week total 250. Outside the main sample (population < 500k) but would distort the all-countries robustness check. Verify with IDMC before publication

decision: BUILD_LOG [CONFIRM] lines checked against the downloaded files: GW overrides CZE/SRB/YEM/VNM; economies absent from UCDP; CRU climatology-fill lists (Pr: CPV, SLB and small territories; Tc: IOT, MNP, SLB, UMI); MNE A_R break; IDMC column; VUT 2015
reason: Each was checked on the raw file in the session of 2026-10-13 (see D-010 to D-020). Also reviewed: Tuvalu health spending 27% of GDP (2023) is outside the sample and plausible for an aid-financed micro-state; Dominica 2017 displacement 51% of population (Hurricane Maria) kept as true

decision: D-001 signed by Rushabh Shah (RS) and D-021 approved by RS; plan treated as locked for Step 5 on his instruction. Co-author signatures (TP, MK, NS, LC) still to be added
reason: RS instructed to proceed on 2026-10-13. Any change after this needs a new entry before re-running

decision: H2 implementation: PPML on M (counts, so zeros are kept) with log regressors Np, H (=HY*Y), Y, K+1, A_L, A_R, Pi3, Pi4 and year effects. Y_ref and D_ref vary only by year, so year effects absorb them; together with tau (1 year) they can balance any N, C and T imbalance. The one restriction left that the data can test is gamma_Np + gamma_K + gamma_AL + gamma_AR = 1 (Wald, 1 df, country-clustered)
reason: Derived before running: the restriction vector w must be orthogonal to the dimensions of Y_ref, D_ref and tau, giving w = (2,2,1,0) over (N,C,L,T). The plan said one df per base dimension; that is not identifiable once year effects are in

decision: H3/H4 forecasting: predictions for test years use the fitted country effects, the average of the training-year effects, and the observed Pi values of the test years (conditional forecast). Countries whose training outcome is all zero are predicted 0. Per-country error = mean over test years of |ln(pred+c)-ln(obs+c)|; reported metric = median over countries. H4 CI: 2,000 bootstrap resamples of countries, seed 2026
reason: Year effects for future years are unknown; the training average is the neutral choice. Fixed before running

decision: Migration index (exploratory, not a hypothesis test): defined from the between-country model (7.5) as the fitted displacement rate exp(X beta), using all Pi groups. A leave-one-region-out check (model refitted without the held-out region, no region effects) reports the rank correlation between index and observed rates in each held-out region
reason: The goal is an index that can be applied to regions without a history of their own, which the within-country model (country effects) cannot do. Added before any model was fitted

decision: Study 2 Phase 1 pre-registered (STUDY2_PHASE1_PLAN.md): physical exposure shares F (Global Flood Database), C (IBTrACS 64 kt, 100 km), D (SPEI-12 <= -1.5) with GHS-POP; 2008-2018; tests P1 to P4 and decision gate fixed before any data are pulled
reason: Study 1 found no signal from annual climate anomalies; existing displacement models (IDMC GDRM, CLIMADA, IOM RICD) use people in hazard footprints. New hypothesis, so Study 1 results stand unchanged

decision: Exposure code fix: sum population in EPSG:4326 as density x true pixel area instead of in the GHS-POP Mollweide grid; all 11 export tasks cancelled and restarted
reason: Earth Engine failed for 2008 and 2009 (Unable to transform edge ... World_Mollweide to EPSG:4326) on polygons near the Mollweide edge. Definitions, years, thresholds and tests are unchanged; no exposure values had been produced or seen

decision: Exposure export made cheaper, same definitions: cyclone zones painted as 1 km-accurate geodesic buffers instead of a per-pixel distance transform; permanent water taken from the same year's flood events instead of all 913; each year split into 4 country batches (44 tasks); scale stays 100 m; all years rerun with this one code version
reason: The 2009 task hit Earth Engine's 12-hour limit (Computation timed out, 4.2 million EECU-seconds); 2008 and 2010 finished at 10 h and 6 h, so later years were at risk too. Exposure definitions, thresholds, years and tests are unchanged; the 2008 and 2010 files were not opened or used
